## <span aria-hidden="true">♿</span> Accessibility & UX Checklist / এক্সেসিবিলিটি চেকলিস্ট

- [ ] All icon-only buttons have explicit `aria-label` attributes.
- [ ] Keyboard focus states (`:focus-visible`) are distinct and visible.
- [ ] Color contrast meets WCAG AA standards.
- [ ] Bilingual support (English & Bengali / বাংলা) is respected where applicable.
- [ ] Interactive elements provide feedback during loading/async states.
